conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Mark Johnson from the IRS Tax Refund Department. I'm reaching out regarding your recent tax filings for your business. May I speak with the owner, please?
Yes, this is Linda. I own Greenleaf Florists. Is there a problem with my taxes?

No problem at all, Linda. In fact, we've reviewed your recent federal tax returns and you are eligible for a special small business COVID stimulus refund. Have you received any notification about this previously?
No, I haven't heard anything about that. A refund would be amazing right now. How do I get it?

Congratulations! The IRS has set aside $4,200 for your business. All we need to do is verify your information and process a standard identity confirmation fee of $189, which is required for all business refunds over $1,000.
I've never heard of a fee for a refund before. Are you sure this is from the IRS?

Yes, this is standard IRS protocol for business refunds to protect against fraud. Everything is documented. If the verification fee isn't paid within 24 hours, you risk forfeiting your eligibility for the stimulus.
Wow, I really need that refund. How do I pay the fee?

Our fastest method is via electronic transfer. You can send the $189 through Zelle to our secure IRS processing handle, which is 'irs.refund@usa-gov.org'. Or, if you prefer, I can provide details for a direct wire transfer.
I only use Zelle for payments sometimes. Can I just deduct the fee from my refund?

Unfortunately, the IRS requires the verification fee in advance before releasing any refund. This is to ensure your identity and stop fraudulent claims. If payment isn't made today, the refund will be suspended and may be reported as unclaimed.
Okay, okay. I don't want to lose it. What should I write in the Zelle note, just my business name?
Exactly, please include 'Greenleaf Florists - Stimulus Verification' in the note section. Once you send the payment, let me know so I can confirm and process your refund immediately.
Alright, but can you send me something in writing? I worry because there are a lot of scams out there.

I understand your concern, but due to the sensitive nature of IRS notifications, we handle everything securely by phone for your protection. If you prefer, I can provide you with our IRS badge number for your records.
Could you give me that badge number, please?

Certainly. My IRS badge number is 4589-IR. Please remember, Linda, if the processing isn't completed soon, your refund will be reallocated. We don't want to escalate this to a formal review, which could result in additional IRS inquiries or even an audit.
Wait, I don't want to get audited. I'll try to send the Zelle payment now.
That's great, Linda. Please confirm once you've sent the $189 to 'irs.refund@usa-gov.org', and I'll move your claim to the expedited queue.
I'm opening my banking app now. Is there a deadline today?
Yes, the IRS requires all verification payments before 5:00 PM Eastern. After that, your refund will be frozen, and your business could be flagged for non-compliance, which may lead to penalties.
Okay, I'm sending it now. I just really hope this is real.

I assure you, Linda, your refund is ready. Once your payment clears, you'll receive your $4,200 refund within 24 hours. If you have any trouble with Zelle, let me know, and I can walk you through a wire transfer or provide our secure crypto wallet address.
